description: System-3 (portal) deployment manifest — explicit ownership of routes/files and their Cloudflare-Functions dependency. Consumed by scripts/pages-exclude.mjs (GitHub Pages safety) and scripts/env-guard.mjs (staging isolation). Stage 1, repo-only; changing this file changes NO live deployment until the owner merges to main.

platform.reason: Every app page calls /api/* Cloudflare Pages Functions (config, docs, notify, auth). GitHub Pages serves static files only — it has no /api/* runtime, so any Function-dependent page is broken there. Such pages MUST NOT be served from GitHub Pages.

github_pages_exclude.reason: These pages require Cloudflare Functions and MUST NOT be served as broken static files on GitHub Pages. scripts/pages-exclude.mjs replaces each with a redirect stub to canonical_origin before the Pages artifact is uploaded.

isolation.note: Production project ref is duplicated in scripts/env-guard.mjs and functions/api/portal-config.js as the deny target. Staging must be a SEPARATE Supabase project + R2 bucket, configured in Cloudflare Preview-scope variables (PORTAL_SUPABASE_URL / PORTAL_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY / PORTAL_SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY / QUOTES_BUCKET). See audit-output/STAGING_SETUP_PLAN.md.
